description:
Rewrites the parallel LDPC decoding passage of the acceleration how-to page to use the batch soft-decoder trait.

## Background

The batch soft-decoder trait of `gf2-coding` decodes a batch of LLR frames into caller-provided decoded words and per-frame outcomes in input order. Its LDPC implementer, the LDPC batch decoder, decodes fixed waves of eight lanes with per-frame termination, routes a wave to the lane kernels or to the single-frame decoder by the decode selectors of the coding tuning section, and returns each frame's result equal to the single-frame decoder's bit for bit as `docs/reference/ldpc-decoder-numerical-contract.md` states. A pooled batch decoder over the trait gives parallel decoding with one inner decoder per worker. `LdpcDecoder::decode_batch` and `decode_batch_with_config` predate the trait: they build one single-frame decoder per frame, on rayon under the `parallel` feature, and return message bits with iteration counts and flags. The page `docs/how-to/select-acceleration.md` shows parallel LDPC decoding with `LdpcDecoder::decode_batch_with_config`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `docs/how-to/select-acceleration.md` shows parallel LDPC decoding through the batch soft-decoder trait with the pooled batch decoder, and names neither inherent batch function.
- [hard] REQ-02: The passage is in the present tense, states no measured figure, and its code sample compiles as a documentation test or matches a compiled example.
title: Show parallel LDPC decoding through the batch trait in the how-to page
